blocks.x: Technology & SaaS delivered as an operating capability for Technology & SaaS, not a slide deck — durable runtime, policy-checked actions, and telemetry your auditors can read without translation.

Software companies eat their own cooking or get eaten: platform engineering, SRE discipline and FinOps are not nice-to-haves but the operating system of companies whose product is infrastructure. The AI era adds a new economics layer — inference cost per customer, model quality per feature, data moats per vertical — that decides which SaaS companies compound margin and which dilute it.

blocks.x: The competitive math is unforgiving: NRR (net revenue retention) is decided by product velocity and reliability; enterprise procurement gates on SOC 2/ISO 27001 evidence; AI features must launch in weeks against well-funded rivals while keeping unit economics sane. Meanwhile data products — benchmarks, telemetry insights, vertical datasets — have become a second revenue line for companies that can build the privacy and entitlement plumbing.
